unit_cn: Unit 5 The Value of Money 金钱的价值
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 5 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、金钱观/《百万英镑》/理财主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The clerk did not believe a poor-looking man could be rich.
words.example_cn: 店员不相信一个衣着寒酸的人会有钱。

words.example_en: Henry went to the American consulate to ask for help, but got none.
words.example_cn: 亨利去美国领事馆求助,却没得到任何帮助。

words.example_en: I dare not buy all these clothes without any money.
words.example_cn: 我身无分文,不敢买下这些衣服。

words.meaning_cn: 顺楼梯而下;在楼下;往楼下
words.example_en: The clerk told him the cheaper suits were downstairs.
words.example_cn: 店员告诉他便宜的西装在楼下。

words.example_en: Henry felt it was his duty to attend the ambassador's party.
words.example_cn: 亨利觉得参加大使的聚会是他的责任。

words.example_en: He said he would be on duty at the library this afternoon.
words.example_cn: 他说今天下午他要在图书馆值班。

words.example_en: A good scene must include every element of a play.
words.example_cn: 一个好的场景必须包含戏剧的每一个要素。

words.example_en: Eventually the shop owner realised the bank note was real.
words.example_cn: 店主最终意识到那张钞票是真的。

words.example_en: The consulate could help him to some extent, but not fully.
words.example_cn: 领事馆能在一定程度上帮他,但帮不了太多。

words.meaning_cn: 外部的;外面的;外界的;外来的
words.example_en: We should not judge people by their external appearance.
words.example_cn: 我们不应以外表来评判别人。

words.example_en: The clerk looked at Henry's worn coat with a frown.
words.example_cn: 店员皱着眉头看亨利那件破旧的外套。

words.example_en: The owner thought Henry was hesitating to pay the bill.
words.example_cn: 店主以为亨利在迟疑着不肯付账。

words.example_en: I was so happy at the news that I gave him a hug.
words.example_cn: 我听到这消息太高兴了,给了他一个拥抱。

words.example_en: While listening, don't ignore the speaker's tone and feelings.
words.example_cn: 听的时候,别忽视说话人的语气和情绪。

words.example_en: Keep some cash in case you lose your money on a trip.
words.example_cn: 随身带些现金,以防旅途中弄丢了钱。

words.example_en: She helped the stranger and expected nothing in return.
words.example_cn: 她帮助了那个陌生人,不求任何回报。

words.example_en: You will need many suits, yes, indeed you will.
words.example_cn: 你会需要很多套西装,真的,你确实会。

words.example_en: The implied meaning often indicates people's true feelings.
words.example_cn: 言外之意往往暗示着人们真实的情感。

words.example_en: Henry had no intention of taking the brothers' charity.
words.example_cn: 亨利无意接受两兄弟的施舍。

words.meaning_cn: 评价;评判;判断;法官;裁判
words.example_en: You shouldn't judge people by the clothes they wear.
words.example_cn: 你不应以衣着来评判别人。

words.example_en: She had spent all her savings and taken out a large loan.
words.example_cn: 她花光了所有积蓄,还借了一大笔贷款。

words.example_en: He had to take out a loan to pay for his daughter's care.
words.example_cn: 他不得不贷款来支付女儿的治疗费用。

words.example_en: Henry wanted to maintain a good relationship with the ambassador.
words.example_cn: 亨利想和大使保持良好的关系。

words.meaning_cn: 举止;行为方式;方法;[pl.]礼貌
words.example_en: The first clerk spoke to Henry in a rude manner.
words.example_cn: 第一个店员用粗鲁的态度对亨利说话。

words.example_en: Back in America, Henry had worked for a mining company.
words.example_cn: 在美国时,亨利曾在一家采矿公司工作。

words.example_en: Philip bought two tickets to watch a musical with his girlfriend.
words.example_cn: 菲利普买了两张票要和女友去看音乐剧。

words.example_en: The narration tells the audience what is happening in the play.
words.example_cn: 解说告诉观众剧中正在发生什么。

words.meaning_cn: (书、戏剧、电影中的)叙述者;讲述者
words.example_en: The narrator explains how the two brothers made their bet.
words.example_cn: 叙述者解释了两兄弟是如何打赌的。

words.example_en: The owner said it was quite normal for a busy man to be moving.
words.example_cn: 店主说一个大忙人正在搬家是很正常的。

words.example_en: Henry was stuck in London with nowhere to stay.
words.example_cn: 亨利困在伦敦,无处落脚。

words.example_en: She felt a moral obligation to return the money she had found.
words.example_cn: 她觉得有道义上的责任把捡到的钱还回去。

words.example_en: Henry felt it was odd that he could not open the letter at once.
words.example_cn: 亨利觉得不能马上拆信这件事很奇怪。

words.example_en: He bought tickets for an opera at the weekend.
words.example_cn: 他买了周末去看歌剧的票。

words.meaning_cn: 可选择的事物;选择;选择权
words.example_en: The shop offered Henry a wide range of options to choose from.
words.example_cn: 店里给亨利提供了一大堆可供挑选的款式。

words.example_en: It is getting late, so I ought to be on my way now.
words.example_cn: 时间不早了,我该上路了。

words.example_en: Have patience, and you will soon learn the whole story.
words.example_cn: 耐心一点,你很快就会知道整件事的来龙去脉。

words.example_en: She kindly permitted the poor traveller to sit beside her.
words.example_cn: 她好心地允许这个穷旅客坐在她身边。

words.example_en: "I'd love to sit down, with your permission," said Henry.
words.example_cn: 亨利说:“若您允许,我很乐意坐下。”

words.example_en: A good play needs a clear and exciting plot.
words.example_cn: 一部好戏需要清晰而扣人心弦的情节。

words.example_en: Henry had to postpone opening the letter until two o'clock.
words.example_cn: 亨利只得把拆信推迟到两点钟。

words.example_en: Lily decided to settle in New York and pursue her dream of acting.
words.example_cn: 莉莉决定在纽约定居,追求她的演员梦。

words.example_en: Henry was sailing alone when a strong wind carried him out to sea.
words.example_cn: 亨利独自航行时,一阵大风把他刮向了大海。

words.example_en: There is a saying that money is a good servant but a bad master.
words.example_cn: 有句谚语说,金钱是好仆人,却是坏主人。

words.example_en: The students were asked to write a new scene for the play.
words.example_cn: 学生们被要求为这部剧写一个新场景。

words.example_en: Money is a good servant and a bad master.
words.example_cn: 金钱是好仆人,也是坏主人。

words.example_en: Henry hoped the brothers could offer him some sort of work.
words.example_cn: 亨利希望两兄弟能给他某种工作。

words.meaning_cn: 看见;注意到;发现;地点;斑点
words.example_en: The next morning he was spotted by a passing ship.
words.example_cn: 第二天早上他被一艘过往的船发现了。

words.example_en: He went down some stairs to look for a cheaper suit.
words.example_cn: 他走下几级楼梯去找便宜些的西装。

words.example_en: Henry saw a sign for a tailor's shop and went in for a coat.
words.example_cn: 亨利看到一家裁缝店的招牌,便进去买外套。

words.example_en: To be honest, I have no money at all right now.
words.example_cn: 说实话,我现在身无分文。

words.meaning_cn: 上面的;上层的;靠上部的
words.example_en: The ambassador invited Henry to an upper-class party.
words.example_cn: 大使邀请亨利参加一场上流社会的聚会。

words.example_en: Why was the owner willing to wait so long to get paid?
words.example_cn: 店主为什么愿意等这么久才收钱呢?
